name: Hi Hi Puffy AmiYumi
description: Hi Hi Puffy AmiYumi follows the adventures of two very cool, but very different pop stars as they travel from gig to gig or just hang out in their tour bus. Being famous rock stars, Ami and Yumi tour the globe in their customized Puffy bus, a veritable condo on wheels with all the major amenities and an ever-changing interior. Ami is the peppy, positive, and resourceful one. Yumi is the hard-rocking, no-nonsense cynic with an absolutely infallible sense of cool. Together, these superstars take the world by storm with musical talent, trend-setting style and humor, despite occasional misjudgments from their well-meaning but tragically square manager, Kaz.

videos.title: Dis-Harmony
videos.overview: Kaz finds Ami and Yumi's so called number one fan and they think she's nice at first, but then she starts following them EVERYWHERE they go!

videos.title: Collect All 5!
videos.overview: Ami is driven to the brink of insanity, while trying to find a bunny huggles doll out of her favorite cereal ""Super Rainbow Blast"" so she can make a ""Super Cuddle Love Hug""

videos.title: Ninjcompoop
videos.overview: Ami gives Yumi a career test and it comes out as Ninja, so Yumi becomes a ninja using her at home ninja kit, complete with bio-degraitable ninja monkey for a teacher, but she takes the ninja thing too far...

videos.title: Talent Suckers
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi are tricked out of their talents by a trio of vampires.

videos.title: Ole!
videos.overview: When Ami and Yumi inadvertently best a bull while attending a bullfight in Latin America, they’re regarded as heroes. Now the town expects them to fight El Diablo, the toughest bull in the country.

videos.title: Mini-Puffs
videos.overview: Manager Kaz begins a new gig involving baby "reincarnations" of Ami and Yumi known as the "Mini-Puffs".

videos.title: Ami's Secret
videos.overview: Yumi and Kaz thinks Ami will go solo because of her secret career as a clown...

videos.title: Taffy Trouble
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi have to pay the rent for the bus when Kaz came up with the idea and they get a job as taffy makers at Wacky Wally's candy factory.

videos.title: Dance A-Go-Go
videos.overview: Ami signs herself and Yumi up to a dance contest. But when a competitor stubs Ami's toe, it's up to Yumi to use her rock star knowledge to win.

videos.title: Ami Goes Bad
videos.overview: When Yumi is stealing all of the spotlight by her badness, Ami gets jealous and purchases a pair of haunted sticks from the pawn shoppe, but it's Crazy Stix's Sticks, and Kaz and Yumi must get those sticks away from Ami before things get worse!

videos.title: Robo-Pop
videos.overview: Kaz orders robot-type clones of Ami & Yumi, but when he orders a whole fleet of them, it's up to Ami & Yumi to stop the robot fleet before they lose their rock-star jobs!

videos.title: Metal Mental
videos.overview: A new group playing Metal called Metal Breath comes to the Puffy bus on tour with them and Ami & Yumi must get them out before they stay only the opening band for concerts!

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi accidently let 3 bandits out of jail and then they are blamed for it and are on wanted posters, so they decide "showdown" with the bandits!

videos.title: In The Cards
videos.overview: When Ami and Yumi are infatuated with a boy who is obsessed with a card game called "Stu-Pi-Doh", so they decide to play Stu-Pi-Doh to see who gets the boy.

videos.title: Team Teen
videos.overview: The duo stops a villain, so the superhero group "Team Teen" grants them superpowers and they join their team, but they soon find out Team Teen follows teenage restrictions and is the lamest group of superheros... ever! But when they are in trouble, Ami and Yumi must go to their rescue!

videos.title: Opera Yumi
videos.overview: Yumi has a run-in with her old singing teacher, the snooty, opera-loving Madame Blubbery, who uses a hypnotic whistle to force Yumi to give up rock music and sing in her newly-written opera. Can Ami and Kaz get the old Yumi back?

videos.title: Save The Farm
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi go to visit their friends on the Happy Acres Farm, only to find things aren't so happy: the farm is in shambles, and a greedy developer is threatening to buy the land from its kindly owner and build a parking lot. To keep this from happening, Ami and Yumi offer to help fix up the farm, but that soon proves easier said than done.

videos.title: Pen Pal
videos.overview: Ami receives a visit with her romantic-poetry-writing pen-pal Pierre. Unfortunately, her "dreamboat" turns out to be both a certified geek and a certified bore, whose idea of a romantic date involves entomology, volunteer work at the library, and chess.

videos.title: Surf's Up
videos.overview: While surfing, Ami and Yumi get stranded on a deserted island (unaired and originally titled Tsunami Yumi).

videos.title: Stupid Cupids
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi, noticing Kaz being depressed, decide to give him a make-over to get him a girlfriend. Even with his new looks, Kaz's personality gets in the way.

videos.title: Brat Attack
videos.overview: A rich man pays Kaz for Ami & Yumi for his bratty little son, Timmy. Ami & Yumi learn that he's more trouble then he's worth, how will they escape from him?

videos.title: Kaz Almighty
videos.overview: Hawaiians believe that Kaz is a ruler supposed to come there by legend and he starts to "believe" it and it goes to his head.

videos.title: Allergic
videos.overview: Kaz thinks Yumi might be allergic to Ami and needs a break away from her.

videos.title: Spaced Out
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi get abducted by aliens.

videos.title: Yumi Saves Kaz
videos.overview: Yumi saves Kaz from a falling donut sign, and Kaz constantly does favors for Yumi, making it difficult for her.

videos.title: Rock N' Roe
videos.overview: Ami & Yumi eat cheap sushi, and end up in a whacked-out undersea voyage of a hallucination.

videos.title: Scowlitis
videos.overview: Yumi is forced to wear some funky headgear that forces her to smile, in order to prevent scowlitis from taking hold of her.

videos.title: Treasure Map
videos.overview: Kaz, Ami, and Yumi find a map to a treasure and promise each other to share. But lack of trust abound...

videos.title: Kaz vs. Katz
videos.overview: Kaz is force to care for Ami and Yumi's cat while they have the day off.

videos.title: Bad Manager
videos.overview: Kaz loses Ami and Yumi on a bet of Rock-Paper-Scissors. The new manager who won gives them an amazing lap-of-luxary. But after missing Kaz, they give him a chance to win themselves back...

videos.title: The Amazing Kaz-Am
videos.overview: Kaz gets the girls to be his assistants when he fulfills his life long dream of being a magician. Kaz isn't a very good magician though.

videos.title: Puffylicious
videos.overview: Kaz opens a Puffy themed restaurant that the girls have to work in. The girls must get a good review on the restaurant for the sake of the Puffy name.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Danger
videos.overview: A famous director shoots a music video, but when Ami & Yumi have to perform dangerous stunts, they find the video is more trouble than it's worth.

videos.title: Fan Clubs
videos.overview: Ami gets a gift from her fan club and Kaz says she should hide it from Yumi. Then Yumi gets one from her fan club, and Kaz says Yumi should should hide it from Ami. Then, Ami and Yumi keep getting gifts, and Kaz keeps hiding them. Will they find out about each other's fan clubs?

videos.title: Cat Nap
videos.overview: Kaz keeps disturbing the cats' beauty sleep. So the cats play devious tricks on him when he goes to sleep himself.

videos.title: Cursed
videos.overview: During a concert, Ami and Yumi both break their instruments at the same time. Kaz tells them that that gives them 100 years of bad luck, and then they keep getting jinxed. Will they be able to stop getting jinxed before their bad luck lasts longer than anyone's ever lived?

videos.title: Eye Sore
videos.overview: When Kaz accidentally flushes his glasses down the toilet, he makes life a nightmare for Ami and Yumi's cats, who take only so much before they decide to work together to get the manager's lost eyewear back.

videos.title: Mean Machine
videos.overview: Mean Machine: Puffy finds a man with a robot that plays music, but then the robot plays the music and becomes popular. Ami and Yumi must regain their title.

videos.title: Sea Sick
videos.overview: Exhausted from eight straight months of touring, the girls are delighted when Kaz surprises them with tickets to a ocean cruise. Little do they know that the cruise is a seniors cruise and that Kaz has booked them as the ship's band. Will Ami and Yumi be able to get the old ship singer his job back, or are they stuck for a tenure?

videos.title: Koi Fish
videos.overview: After Yumi makes a mistake that leads to their van crashing into the dumpster, Ami discovers an all-knowing Koi fish. Yumi becomes obsessed with it to avoid any more mistakes.

videos.title: Arbor Day
videos.overview: Kaz almost runs over a squirrel who left his home due to Eldwin Blair chopping down trees for toothpicks, Ami and Yumi decide to help the squirrel get his home back. Later on, Ami chains her and Yumi to the tree. Eldwin starts up the bulldozers and chases them through the forest until he surrounds them. Ami manages to convice Eldwin to save the tree.

videos.title: Ami Ami
videos.overview: After Yumi has an accident with the microwave, she thinks she's Ami, which leads to Ami and Kaz trying to get her back to normal in any way they could think of.

videos.title: Visiting Hours
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi come back to their tour bus and find a note that Kaz left saying that he had to go to the hospital. Ami and Yumi go to one to visit him but the nurse kept saying that visiting hours aren't right now and they have to wait until the end of next month. Ami and Yumi keep trying to get in the hospital with the nurse chasing them. They get in a room with a guy who looks like Kaz but was taller. Eventually, The nurse catches them and throws them out. Ami and Yumi are sad but when they come back to the tour bus they find Kaz there and they find out that Kaz just went to the pet hospital for their cats.

videos.title: Kitty Kontest
videos.overview: Kaz enters Ami and Yumi's cats in a contest but turns out the cat contest isn't until October, so Kaz decides to enter the cats in a dog contest by pretending that they're dogs, but it backfires when the cats are told to speak and accidentally meow, and they and Kaz get chased out by the dogs.

videos.title: Chow Down
videos.overview: Unlike Ami and Kaz, Yumi has never won a trophy before. Intent on winning one, she enters a tofu-dog eating contest. When she entered her first contest she lost. She challenged the champion to a rematch and if she won she got the champion's golden teeth, But if she loses, she and Ami must spit polish and clean his teeth for the rest of their lives. When the champion and Yumi get ready, Yumi starts out slow and the champion is winning but Kaz says mentions the baseball game they went to and Ami starts playing baseball. Yumi starts eating the Tofu-dogs fast and ends up winning the champion's gold teeth.

videos.title: Hungry Yumi
videos.overview: When Yumi's midnight hunger strikes she wants a Pink Palace cheeseburger so Yumi convinces Ami to drive her to a Pink Palace location. They end up going everywhere because the other locations get into trouble.

videos.title: The Oddyguard
videos.overview: When getting attacked by fans after shows. Kaz hires them a body guard. When the body guard becomes too protective about his clients things start to go wrong.

videos.title: Song Sung Bad
videos.overview: Kaz writes a song, but Ami and Yumi don't like it, but hides those feelings not to disappoint Kaz.

videos.title: Helping Hand
videos.overview: Yumi's hands get RSI while signing autographs and can't use them, so Ami decides to help Yumi out. Yumi then takes advantage of Ami.

videos.title: Neat Freak
videos.overview: Ami's tired about not having the group being very clean. So Ami is obsessed in cleaning their trailer. But she now can't find her drum sticks so can she find them?

videos.title: Hypno Kaz
videos.overview: A magician named Dr. Mysto tries to hypnotise Yumi and cure her of nail biting. He hypnotises Kaz by mistake.

videos.title: In Harmony's Way
videos.overview: Yumi and Kaz accidentally sell Ami's diary to an auction, the diary is then bought by Harmony so then Ami and Yumi must become Harmony's best friend in order to get the diary back.

videos.title: Time Off
videos.overview: Yumi is tired of Ami always waking her up early, so Yumi sets Ami's clock backwards by 5 seconds. The clock affects Ami as she loses her sense of timing.

videos.title: Home Insecurity
videos.overview: Yumi is tired of Ami using her stuff without her permission, so Yumi gets a security system that attacks whoever comes into her room. But, the security system soon targets Yumi. Can she find a way to stop it?

videos.title: Uninvited
videos.overview: Kaz has a party in a hotel room and doesn't invite Ami and Yumi, now the girls try to sneak into the party.

videos.title: Camping Caper
videos.overview: Ami takes Yumi outside in the wild for some fresh air after she had been in a room for almost a week. Then, Ami gets kidnapped by Bigfoot. Can Yumi save her friend?

videos.title: Cell Block Rock
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi end up in prison after Kaz mistakes them for crooks.

videos.title: AmiYumi 3000
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi are transported to the year 3000 where they discover the whole world is dedicated to them.

videos.title: The Ride Stuff
videos.overview: When Kaz is too short to go on a ride, Ami and Yumi must disguise him(And themselves too) so he can go on the ride. Can they get him on the ride? The name of the episode is a reference to "The right stuff".

videos.title: Were-Kaz
videos.overview: Kaz is sick of being bald so he gets some hair growing liquid to grow his hair back. But suddenly, something scary happens! He becomes a Werewolf! He chases the cats around the bus.

videos.title: Ski Sick
videos.overview: Kaz books a ski trip for him, Ami and Yumi. Yumi wasn't a good skier so Ami signed up Yumi for ski school so she could get better But Yumi gets mad and lies to Ami and says that she passed. Ami finds out she didn't and Yumi said there were monkeys and little kids in the class. They start fighting and then start rolling down the hill. Meanwhile, Kaz is trying to skate across a frozen lake. While rolling down the hill, Ami and Yumi crash into the cabin and break all the bones in their body. In the end, Kaz uses Ami and Yumi as skis to ride down the mountain. The name is a reference to Seasick.

videos.title: Claw and Order
videos.overview: Fed up with the cats scratching up his stuff, Kaz tries to build Jang Keng and Tekerai a scratching post. The name puns Law &Order.

videos.title: Janice Jealous
videos.overview: Chad, The good card game player of Stu-Pi-Doh comes back and has a new girlfriend named Janice. Ami and Yumi start to like Chad again and they start getting Jealous of Janice and they start to follow them everywhere to see what they do together. While following them and getting information of what Janice likes Ami and Yumi change to try to be more like Janice so Chad will like them again. They start dressing and acting like her. Chad falls for them and Janice gets sad and runs off. After hanging out with Ami and Yumi Chad starts to not like them. Later on, Janice comes back and tells Chad that she joined a rock band and she had hair like Ami's. Chad said that it ruled she was in a band. Ami and Yumi get mad and just keeping saying that they rule until the end of the episode.

videos.title: Domo
videos.overview: When Kaz goes out and buys and a dog that looks just like him things start going crazy! When big time company owners come Kaz isn't there but Domo is! So can the girls get back before the company owners leave?

videos.title: Yumi Goes Solo
videos.overview: Yumi gets fed up with Ami and Kaz giving her all the hard work, so she wishes that there was no such thing as Puffy AmiYumi. Her wish came true, but Ami and Kaz are now having a hard life, and Yumi realizes how miserable she is without them.

videos.title: Cat Feud
videos.overview: Kaz, had it with Jang Keng and Tekirai, tries to frame them for various crimes. The name puns Cat Food.

videos.title: Super Zero!
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi are visited by an old friend named Atchan who thinks he's a superhero. Can Atchan help Yumi when she, Ami and Kaz are kidnapped by the giant snake monster Sunikura?

videos.title: Artist Ami
videos.overview: Ami's bad attempt at and album cover is discovered by an art critic who suggests to Ami that she should become an artist.

videos.title: Ikkakujuu
videos.overview: After breaking Yumi's new guitar, Ami tries to convince Yumi and Kaz that she saw a unicorn. This is the only episode where no dialogue is heard in this episode.

videos.title: Run Cat Run
videos.overview: Kaz enters the cats into a racing contest, much to Ami and Yumi's disapproval.

videos.title: Driving School
videos.overview: Ami thinks Yumi and Kaz are dangerous drivers, so she makes them take driving classes.

videos.title: Record Breakers
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi compete with each other to complete a world record.

videos.title: Rock Lobsters
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi tried to save lobsters from a seafood restaurant.

videos.title: Phantom of Rock
videos.overview: Kaz is tired of how Ami and Yumi are playing, so he seeks the help of phantom rocker, Johnny Ghost. Ami and Yumi then get trapped in his haunted mansion.

videos.title: Fungus
videos.overview: Ami adopts a hunk of fungus that comes from their shower.

videos.title: Soapbox Derby
videos.overview: Ami, Yumi and Kaz compete against Axel and Rod Skidmark in a soap box derby.

videos.title: Talent Suckers Return
videos.overview: The Talent Suckers seek a job in order to pay off some debts.

videos.title: Prisoners of Yoyovia
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi become slaves in a country.

videos.title: Secret Origin
videos.overview: In their childhood years, Ami and Yumi arrive at Camp Youwannasushi and are met by Atchan, who tells them about Rumaki the bunk monster. Yumi is grabbed by Rumaki and Ami and Atchan go under the bed to save her. They manage to save Yumi, but she does not believe them because she was in the sack for the whole episode.

videos.title: The Legend of Mei Pie
videos.overview: Yumi needs a new guitar and must accomplish certain tasks to get one. So she meets Master Mei Pie, who sends her to get some items. She collects all the items, but realizes that she was not focusing on her playing.

videos.title: Under the Hood
videos.overview: The tour bus is acting erratically and Ami and Yumi go inside to find out what is wrong. They find out that the man who sold them the bus had moved into its carburetor. The girls get him out and the bus is fine.

videos.title: Movie Madness
videos.overview: Yumi is chosen to be a movie star, but Ami has to be her stunt double.

videos.title: Stop the Presses
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi have to stop other people seeing an embarrassing photo of Ami in the newspaper.

videos.title: Hired Help
videos.overview: Ami asks Wall to help out with the band, but he is not good at it.

videos.title: Puffy BC
videos.overview: In prehistoric times, Primitive Ami and Primitive Yumi create their own music, and Primitive Kaz tries to get the two to join together and form a band.

videos.title: Dupli-Cats
videos.overview: Jeng Keng and Tekirai clone themselves to get rid of Domo after failing the first time.

videos.title: Agent Y
videos.overview: Yumi is mistaken for a secret agent and must handle the real Agent Y's job.

videos.title: Manga Madness
videos.overview: After coming to life, Ami and Yumi's favorite manga characters battle each other. The fight gets out of hand and it is up to Ami and Yumi to stop them.

videos.title: Junior Tapeworm
videos.overview: While focusing on Puffy AmiYumi, Harmony is disturbed by a member of the Junior Tapeworms and she soon becomes a member and is always getting a badge for every achievement she does.

videos.title: Kazalot
videos.overview: Ami must fight the Black Knight to see who will defend Kazalot.

videos.title: The Golden Fleas
videos.overview: When their instruments break, Ami and Yumi go on a quest for golden fleas. They need to find them before the concert is canceled.

videos.title: The Golden Fleas 2
videos.overview: When their instruments break, Ami and Yumi go on a quest for golden fleas. They need to find them before the concert is canceled.

videos.title: Sitcomi-Yumi
videos.overview: The girls and Kaz try out for a sitcom, hoping for good reviews but recieve continuous bad reviews.

videos.title: Spree!
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi win 1 million Yen. They have to think of a way to spend it all in only 6 minutes.

videos.title: Granny
videos.overview: The girls need to find a way to hide their rock-star lives from Ami's grandmother incase she suffers a heart attack.

videos.title: A Grave Mistake
videos.overview: The Talent Suckers use zombies to increase their popularity, but it proves ineffective.

videos.title: Motor Psycho Mamas
videos.overview: A gang of bikers attacks a city. The girls must stop them before they take it over.

videos.title: Oldie AmiYumi
videos.overview: Ami, Yumi and Kaz are too old to be rocking and need to find other enjoyable things to do.

videos.title: Trouble With Mimes
videos.overview: Ami, Yumi and Kaz have trouble with a mime named Si. And need a way to get rid of him.

videos.title: Jungle Prom
videos.overview: The girls go to a prom in the jungle, but are in danger of missing it.

videos.title: Truth or Dare
videos.overview: The girls play a game of Truth or Dare.

videos.title: Sumo Kaz
videos.overview: With the help of the girls, Kaz trains to become a sumo wrestler and has his first match.

videos.title: Tooth Decay
videos.overview: When Yumi accidentally injures the tooth fairy, she and Ami become tooth fairies for one night. But soon they meet a little boy who would do anything to keep his tooth.

videos.title: Gridiron Maidens
videos.overview: Ami joins Kaz's football team, not knowing that this is a dangerous sport. Kaz tells the security guard not to let Yumi in, because he does not want her to stop Amy playing. Yumi dresses like a cheerleader and gets in. Seeing that Ami doesn't have a chance against the other players, Yumi helps her without Ami realising it.

videos.title: Sound Off
videos.overview: The show is spoiled because the animators fall asleep. Yumi has Kaz's voice, Ami has Yumi's voice and Kaz has animal voices.

videos.title: Small Stuff
videos.overview: When Ami and Yumi shrink in the drier to mouse size, they need to find a way to get back to normal size while being chased by their own cats.

videos.title: B.C. Road Trip
videos.overview: Kaz tries to find a way to carry Ami and Yumi's instruments to their next gig without the need of a tour bus.

videos.title: Puffynauts
videos.overview: Ami, Yumi, and Kaz get lost in space as they head to their next gig.

videos.title: Evil AmiYumi
videos.overview: When Yumi is struck by lightning, she is sent to an alternate universe where everyone is evil. Meanwhile, Yumi's evil counterpart is put in Yumi's place and wreaks havoc.

videos.title: Butterscotch
videos.overview: Kaz accidentally knocks out a horse named Butterscotch, and Ami and Yumi dress up as the horse to help Kaz out at a rodeo.

videos.title: Big Waldo
videos.overview: An alligator named Waldo appears and startles Ami and Yumi. The girls then try to get rid of him.

videos.title: Disco Caper
videos.overview: Ami and Yumi travel back in time to become disco stars.

videos.title: House Unkeeping
videos.overview: The girls are denied access to the Rock Legends museum since they've never trashed a hotel room. Ami and Yumi try their best, but the plan becomes thwarted by an efficient maid.

videos.title: Number, Please
videos.overview: Ami's cell phone overuse causes Kaz to take her cell phone away, leaving Ami to find alternate methods to communicate with other people.

videos.title: Manga Madness, Part II
videos.overview: Kaz gets sent into a manga where he is captured by Mr. Maestro. Ami and Yumi try to rescue their manager with the aid of two heroes, a pencil, and an eraser.

videos.title: Julie AmiYumi
videos.overview: Julie (Lara Jill Miller) comes for a visit. She does nice things to Yumi, but mean things to Ami(Such as calling her Arthur and pretending she doesn't exist). When they go to their concert, Julie is not treated as a star. When the concert is over, she goes to a dark alley and plots revenge.

videos.title: It's Alive!
videos.overview: Evil scientist Ami and her assistant Yumi create the perfect manager, "KAZ". When Harmony, their Number 1 villager, gets into their castle, the monster escapes and gets into Harmony's house. When he leaves again, he pushes over a table with candles on it, causing the house to burn down. Harmony gets angry and organizes a mob of villagers to storm the castle. Meanwhile Ami and Yumi are making another monster. They hear the door-bell and, when they open the door, Harmony and two other villagers run into the castle and start to destroy it. Suddenly Kaz comes back and Yumi finds out that he had only been behaving strangely because he could not see. She gives him glasses and then he convinces the villagers that they are not mad scientists, but musicians. To thank Kaz, they make a wife for him. This is the series finale.
